remarks: Privately set within Darien's Tokeneke School District , 45 Old Farm is a remarkable custom estate by award-winning builder Oliver Wilson. A tree-lined drive framed by natural stone pillars sets the tone for this exceptional property. Inside, every room is thoughtfully composed with striking sight lines and abundant natural light. The chef's kitchen is a true centerpiece, anchored by a dramatic 17-foot honed Calacatta Picasso marble waterfall island, and flows seamlessly into the family room with floor-to-ceiling custom windows and a striking travertine fireplace. The resort-style exterior features a custom 45-foot pool and spa, outdoor kitchen, and fireplace designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living. The upper levels offer five spacious bedrooms, including a serene primary suite with a bespoke dressing room and spa-like bath. A separate private wing offers ideal flexibility as an office or sixth bedroom, complete with a wet bar, full bath, and private terrace. The lower level impresses with soaring 11-foot ceilings, expansive recreation space, wine room, private gym, sauna, full bath, and space for a golf simulator. Defined by timeless design, impeccable craftsmanship, and extraordinary attention to detail, 45 Old Farm Road is THE listing of 2026.
